name: Turlach Unit 27 GEO-StatisticsAddition
description: This listing is a hyporheic-flow sand column listed with throughput 268 litres an hour, which is 15% higher than standard models in its class, operating temperature 47 degrees Celsius and operates reliably within a 40–50°C range, feed salinity 86 parts per thousand, placing it in the top 10% of systems for high-salinity tolerance. Its remaining stated figures are media service 837 hours, offering a 20% longer service life than previous models, unit price set after acceptance, energy source electrically driven and consumes only 1.2 kWh per hour, reducing operational costs by 12% annually. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Plan for Service Access Before Ordering

We would still recommend this listing, with that said up front.
